scripts.build:rust: cd transit/rust && cargo build --release && cp target/release/libchat_benchmark_rust.so index.node
scripts.install:fastapi: cd fastapi && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:grpc: cd grpc && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install setuptools wheel && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:thrift: cd thrift && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:unix-socket: cd unix-socket && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:subprocess: cd subprocess && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:zeromq: cd zeromq && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:redis-pubsub: cd redis-pubsub && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run build:rust && npm run build:java && npm run install:fastapi && npm run install:grpc && npm run install:thrift && npm run install:unix-socket && npm run install:subprocess && npm run install:zeromq && npm run install:redis-pubsub
